facts.fact_text: On 7 April 2003 at 5 p.m. a demonstration was held in the centre of Yerevan on the occasion of Mother's Day.
The demonstration of 7 April 2003 appears to have been of a political nature.
The applicant took part in the demonstration of 7 April 2003.
The applicant took part in the march that followed the demonstration of 7 April 2003.
In her written statement of 7 April 2003, the applicant stated that she was in the front line holding the Armenian flag and screaming "justice".

According to the record of the court hearing of 7 April 2003, the applicant submitted that at 4.30 p.m. she had participated in a march which had taken place in the Central District of Yerevan, during which they had obstructed the traffic and invited other people to join them.

One of the arresting police officers reported to the Head of the Central District Police Station of Yerevan that during the march of 9 April 2003 after the demonstration next to the Research Institute of Ancient Manuscripts (Մատենադարան) he noticed one citizen who was violating public order: waving a flag while walking on the driveway, obstructing the regular traffic of public transport, creating an emergency situation, randomly hitting passers-by who were not taking part in the demonstration with the long flagpole, and inciting others to follow her example.
According to the applicant, the march of 9 April 2003 was blocked at the very beginning of the Mashtots Avenue by special forces.
According to the applicant, since the demonstrators insisted on continuing their march on 9 April 2003, the special forces started to disperse the demonstration with rubber clubs.
The applicant was taken to the Central District Police Station of Yerevan (ՀՀ ոստիկանության Երևան քաղաքի կենտրոնական բաժին).
At the Central District Police Station of Yerevan, the applicant found out that she had been arrested for having participated in the demonstration of 7 April 2003.
At the Central District Police Station of Yerevan, the arresting police officers drew up a record of the applicant's arrest (արձանագրություն բերման ենթարկելու մասին).
The record of the applicant's arrest stated that the applicant had been "arrested at 7.30 p.m. at 12 Khorhurdneri Street for violating public order".

The police officers drew up a record of an administrative offence (վարչական իրավախախտման արձանագրություն) in which it was stated that the applicant had "participated in a march and violated public order" on 7 April 2003.
The applicant's actions on 7 April 2003 were qualified under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") as minor hooliganism.

Judge M. of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, after a brief hearing, sentenced the applicant under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO) to an administrative fine of 1500 Armenian drams (approximately EUR 2.4 at the material time) in relation to the events of 7 April 2003.

Judge M. of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan sentenced the applicant under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO) to five days of administrative detention in relation to the events of 9 April 2003.
Following the sentence pronounced by Judge M. on 9 April 2003, the applicant was taken to a detention centre where she served her sentence.

The police officers drew up a record of an administrative offence on 9 April 2003 in which it was stated that the applicant had "made a loud noise with a group of people, and randomly insulted and hit passers-by in the Central District".
The applicant's actions on 9 April 2003 were qualified under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO) as minor hooliganism.

The applicant put her signature in the section of the record of an administrative offence of 7 April 2003 certifying that she had been made aware of her rights under Article 267 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO).

The applicant put her signature in the section of the record of an administrative offence of 9 April 2003 certifying that she had been made aware of her rights under Article 267 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO).
The record of the applicant's arrest stated that the applicant had been "arrested at 7.30 p.m. at 12 Khorhurdneri Street for violating public order".

The arresting police officers drew up a record of the applicant's arrest on 9 April 2003 in which it was stated that she had been "arrested for having violated public order during the march of 9 April 2003".

Judge M. of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, after a brief hearing, sentenced the applicant under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO) to an administrative fine of 1500 Armenian drams (approximately EUR 2.4 at the material time) in relation to the events of 7 April 2003.

Judge M. of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan sentenced the applicant under Article 172 of the Code of Administrative Offences (CAO) to five days of administrative detention in relation to the events of 9 April 2003.

According to the record of the court hearing of 7 April 2003, the applicant submitted that at 4.30 p.m. she had participated in a march which had taken place in the Central District of Yerevan, during which they had obstructed the traffic and invited other people to join them.

One of the arresting police officers reported to the Head of the Central District Police Station of Yerevan that during the march of 9 April 2003 after the demonstration next to the Research Institute of Ancient Manuscripts (Մատենադարան) he noticed one citizen who was violating public order: waving a flag while walking on the driveway, obstructing the regular traffic of public transport, creating an emergency situation, randomly hitting passers-by who were not taking part in the demonstration with the long flagpole, and inciting others to follow her example.
According to the applicant, the march of 9 April 2003 was blocked at the very beginning of the Mashtots Avenue by special forces.
According to the applicant, since the demonstrators insisted on continuing their march on 9 April 2003, the special forces started to disperse the demonstration with rubber clubs.

The applicant alleged that traffic was suspended by the traffic police on the relevant stretch of the Mashtots Avenue prior to the commencement of the demonstration of 7 April 2003 in order to facilitate its conduct.
The applicant alleged that she was forced to sign the record of an administrative offence and other documents prepared by the police officers on 7 April 2003 under threat of violence.
The applicant alleged that the police officers persuaded her to refuse a lawyer on 7 April 2003 by insisting that a lawyer's involvement would not help and would only be detrimental to her case.
On 8 April 2003 the applicant complained to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Prosecutor (Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքների դատախազ) about the events of 7 April 2003.
In her complaint of 8 April 2003 to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Prosecutor, the applicant submitted that she had been arrested on false accusations.

In her complaint of 8 April 2003 to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Prosecutor, the applicant submitted that the police officers had drafted a document and forced her to sign it without reading it.

In her complaint of 8 April 2003 to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Prosecutor, the applicant submitted that at about 12.30 a.m. she had been brought before a judge who had sentenced her to a fine without any examination of the case.
The applicant alleged that in reply to her complaint of 8 April 2003 she was asked to appear in two days.
It appears that the applicant did not pursue her complaint of 8 April 2003 to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Prosecutor any further.

On 15 April 2003 the applicant applied to a local human rights NGO called February 22nd («Փետրվարի 22» իրավապաշտպան կազմակերպություն), complaining about the events of 7 and 9 April 2003 and seeking its assistance.

In her application of 15 April 2003 to the NGO February 22nd, the applicant submitted that on 7 April 2003 the police officers had prepared some documents and forced her to sign them without even familiarising herself with them first.
On 18 April 2003 the NGO February 22nd complained to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Prosecutor (Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքների դատախազ) on behalf of the applicant.

By a letter of 12 May 2003 the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Prosecutor (Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքների դատախազ) informed the NGO February 22nd that the decisions of 7 and 9 April 2003 had been well-founded and there were no grounds for appeal.
